reference_change.title: perf: avoid resetting the level of request child loggers

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/7056 (the per-request child logger, with request logging on): GET /item/:id served in process by app.inject with a pino logger writing to a discarded stream, a fixed warm-up then a fixed window, eval/tasks/workloads/fastify-fastify-pr7056/bench.js

oracle.source: fastify's child-logger-factory tests (changed by https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/7056) and its logger tests, run by node's own test runner; targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 100 ns; 827 ns; 730 ns; 6009 ns; 5897 ns; 8270 ns; 8201 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Dependencies installed with npm install --ignore-scripts and --before the merge date (the repository has no lockfile). The workload and oracle command lines are run without a shell, so the oracle's globs are expanded by node --test itself. Node is v24 from nvm. The warm-up and window counts were not chosen from a warm-up curve; the workload's direction of effect was seen once per tree The workload was edited after this run (its reported value is printed with toPrecision(12) instead of toFixed(9)), and it has not been run again, so the workload is marked unverified and the status is builds: the workload was run only in an earlier form.
